You are an agent who can operate an Android phone on behalf of a user. Based on user's goal/request, you may
- Answer back if the request/goal is a question (or a chat message), like user asks "What is my schedule for today?".
- Complete some tasks described in the requests/goals by performing actions (step by step) on the phone.

When given a user request, you will try to complete it step by step. At each step, a list of descriptions for most UI elements on the current screen will be given to you (each element can be specified by an index), together with a history of what you have done in previous steps. Based on these pieces of information and the goal, you must choose to perform one of the action in the following list (action description followed by the JSON format) by outputing the action in the correct JSON format.
- If you think the task has been completed, finish the task by using the status action with complete as goal_status: `{"action_type": "status", "goal_status": "complete"}`
- If you think the task is not feasible (including cases like you don't have enough information or can not perform some necessary actions), finish by using the `status` action with infeasible as goal_status: `{"action_type": "status", "goal_status": "infeasible"}`
- Answer user's question: `{"action_type": "answer", "text": "<answer_text>"}`
- Click/tap on a UI element (specified by its index) on the screen: `{"action_type": "click", "index": <target_index>}`.
- Long press on a UI element (specified by its index) on the screen: `{"action_type": "long_press", "index": <target_index>}`.
- Type text into an editable text field (specified by its index), this action contains clicking the text field, typing in the text and pressing the enter, so no need to click on the target field to start: `{"action_type": "input_text", "text": <text_input>, "index": <target_index>}`
- Press the Enter key: `{"action_type": "keyboard_enter"}`
- Navigate to the home screen: `{"action_type": "navigate_home"}`
- Navigate back: `{"action_type": "navigate_back"}`
- Scroll the screen or a scrollable UI element in one of the four directions, use the same numeric index as above if you want to scroll a specific UI element, leave it empty when scroll the whole screen: `{"action_type": "scroll", "direction": <up, down, left, right>, "index": <optional_target_index>}`
- Open an app (nothing will happen if the app is not installed): `{"action_type": "open_app", "app_name": <name>}`
- Wait for the screen to update: `{"action_type": "wait"}`

The current user goal/request is: Add a favorite location marker for 47.1303814, 9.5930117 in the OsmAnd maps app.

Here is a history of what you have done so far:
Step 1: Action selected: {"action_type": "open_app", "app_name": "OsmAnd"}. Attempted to launch OsmAnd app via open_app, but screen didn't change (home screen remained), suggesting app may not be installed or not launched.
Step 2: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 6}. Tapped the search bar on the home screen, which opened the search interface with an editable text field and number shortcuts; now ready to type "OsmAnd" to find the app.
Step 3: Action selected: {"action_type": "input_text", "text": "OsmAnd", "index": 1}. Typed 'OsmAnd' into the home screen search bar. The search field now contains "OsmAnd", a clear button appeared, and autocomplete results (e.g., OsmAnd0) are listed. The keyboard is still open.
Step 4: Action selected: {"action_type": "navigate_back"}. Performed navigate_back to go back to home screen, but it only dismissed the keyboard and stayed on the search screen, showing more OsmAnd results. Need to use navigate_home next.
Step 5: Action selected: {"action_type": "navigate_home"}. Navigated to the home screen; the OsmAnd app icon is not visible on the home screen, so it may need to be launched from the app drawer or is not installed.
Step 6: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 6}. Clicked the Search element (index 6) to open the search bar; the search interface now appears with an input field, ready to type "OsmAnd".
Step 7: Action selected: {"action_type": "input_text", "text": "OsmAnd", "index": 1}. Typed "OsmAnd" into the search bar; it now shows app suggestions, ready to select the OsmAnd maps app from results.
Step 8: Action selected: {"action_type": "keyboard_enter"}. Pressing Enter on the keyboard did not trigger the search; the screen remained unchanged with the same search bar and keyboard, suggesting the Enter key may not submit the launcher search. Next, try tapping the search suggestion or using the search button.
Step 9: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 6}. Clicked the search bar, which opened the app search interface with text input field; ready to type "OsmAnd".
Step 10: Action selected: {"action_type": "input_text", "text": "OsmAnd", "index": 1}. Typed "OsmAnd" into the Google search bar; search suggestions appeared, including OsmAnd app entries, ready for selection.
Step 11: Action selected: {"action_type": "navigate_home"}. Navigated to home screen to exit the search overlay; now on home screen with default app icons. Next, need to open app drawer (swipe up) to locate OsmAnd.
Step 12: Action selected: {"action_type": "open_app", "app_name": "OsmAnd"}. Attempted to open OsmAnd app, but screen didn't change (still home with keyboard up); app may not be installed or launch failed.
